'''Hutt war droids''' were [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] used by the ancient [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], at a [[Time/Legends|time]] before the Hutts had many servant [[Species/Legends|species]]. Millennia later, [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]]'s [[Troop/Legends|troops]] found a cache of the then-rare [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Varl, which Mika had restored to guard the [[Tempest (starship)|''Tempest'']]. The droids used by Mika were so old that, though their [[Motivator/Legends|motivators]] were fully restored, the same was impossible for their [[battle computer]]s and weapons, which frequently malfunctioned and broke down, although the droids could resort to unarmed melee combat. Each droid had two [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster rifle]], a set of manipulating appendages, a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]] launcher with four grenades, [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. The droids spoke [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] rather than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].

==Behind the scenes==
Since these droids are said to date back to a time when the Hutts had few servant species, they may be pre-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] models predating the [[Treaty of Vontor]].
